recognize_zh: Ki67 在幾乎所有腫瘤細胞核呈陽性（估計 90% 以上），整片呈棕色，只剩極少數陰性細胞；高增生指數符合侵襲性 B 細胞淋巴瘤，但無法單靠 Ki67 區分 Burkitt 與雙打擊淋巴瘤。
features: Nuclear Ki67 positivity in nearly all tumor cells, estimated above 90%
Variable staining intensity with some diffuse background cytoplasmic blush
Only rare unstained cells interspersed in the sheet
Diffuse distribution without nodular or zonal pattern
describe_en: Ki67 immunohistochemistry shows nuclear staining in nearly all neoplastic cells, with a proliferation index estimated at greater than 90% and only rare negative cells. Staining is diffuse without nodular or zonal variation, and there is mild background cytoplasmic blush. A very high proliferation index is characteristic of Burkitt lymphoma and high-grade B-cell lymphomas and, together with BCL2 expression and FISH showing MYC and BCL2 rearrangements in this case, is consistent with high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.

ddx.vs: Burkitt characteristically shows Ki67 near 100% but is BCL2-negative with MYC rearrangement only.
DLBCL usually has a lower and more heterogeneous Ki67 index, although overlap exists.
Blastoid MCL may have a high Ki67 but is cyclin D1-positive.
